selection_rule.eligible: completed valid paired S1/S1B task comparison; mean inferred task-score gain>=0.5 and both paired signs positive, no numerical/identity failure
selection_rule.rank: after numerical validity, paired mean task-score gain/22 divided by measured end-to-end task cost; report both seed values, not a fabricated success probability
selection_rule.tie_break: lower measured cost, then lexicographic task name
selection_rule.fallback: none qualify -> no S2 fits, investigate D-FEATURE/D-LOSS with new approval; do not choose arbitrary tasks

split.outer_exclusion: outer rows excluded from gradients, feature/target stats, epoch selection; used only for final paired comparison
split.algorithm: same codepoint sorting and whole-group cumulative rule as screen, applied outer then inner

templates.inheritance: all scientific fields of selected task H0/H1 exactly retained except this explicit split/seed change; 50 epochs/patience8 unchanged
templates.decision_rule: mean paired outer-score gain>=0.5, at least2/3 positive pairs, no pair below -0.5; thresholds proposed not empirical significance; evaluate uncertainty and validity exposure before further allocation
templates.qualification: fresh split improves sensitivity check but reuses same official train and prior information; not a new independent external test
dependencies: completed paired screen and host selection decision

templates.trigger: candidate passes seed screen but plausible split instability/chemical-coverage concern remains; do not call seed count a substitute for structure coverage
templates.decision_rule: all three split means positive and overall mean>=0.5; if rank reverses, report conditional benefit, no universal win

templates.candidate: one already locked candidate per task
templates.count_rule: 2 tasks * 2 budget bundles * 3 seeds=12 total; subtract only exact 50/8 tuple matches already completed; at most12 new fits
templates.trigger: 50-epoch cap reached with late improvements in >=2 seeds and no clear overfit; not triggered merely because candidate lost
templates.contrast_type: joint epoch-cap/patience bundle; not single-factor attribution
templates.cost: 200 vs50 is 4x epoch ceiling; patience20 vs8 changes realized work nonlinearly. No walltime claim. Not included in small/medium/large default budgets.

deduplication: unique canonical tuple (asset+version,task,full scientific config including preprocessing/loss/monitor/epoch budget,split,scalar seed); metadata/proposal ID not scientific difference. Retried failed job with zero fit is not a completed fit; resumed same trajectory not another independent seed. Shared H0 counted once only when all fields and split/seed match.
